decks.name: Blackbeard
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set battle-of-legends-3. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Blackbeard
hero.specialAbility:
PRIVATEER TURNED PIRATE
Start the game with 1 doubloon in the treasury, you have the other 2. At the start of your turn, you may pay 1 doubloon to gain 1 action. When Blackbeard takes combat damage, pay 1 doubloon.

cards.title: Avast Ye!
cards.immediateText: Your opponent discards 1 random card unless (1 doubloon).
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in Blackbeard's zone unless (1 doubloon).

cards.title: A Brace of Primed Pistols
cards.afterText: Deal 3 damage to an opposing fighter in Blackbeard's zone unless (2 doubloons).

cards.title: Fearsome and Calculating
cards.immediateText: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card for them to discard unless (1 doubloon).

cards.title: Give No Quarter
cards.duringText: If another friendly fighter is adjacent to the opposing fighter, this card's value is 5 instead.
cards.afterText: Gain 1 action unless (1 doubloon).

cards.title: Intimidating Visage
cards.afterText: If Blackbeard is adjacent to an opposing fighter, he recovers 2 health.

cards.title: Light the Fuse
cards.afterText: Move your fighter up to 2 spaces. Then, deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to them.

cards.title: No Prey, No Pay
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, draw 1 card.

cards.title: Parley
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card unless (2 doubloons).

cards.title: Plunder
cards.basicText: Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters. Steal 1 doubloon from the treasury.

cards.title: Queen Anne's Revenge
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
cards.duringText: Subtract 2 from this card's value for each doubloon your opponent pays.

cards.title: Scourge of the Seven Seas
cards.basicText:
Blackbeard recovers 2 health unless (1 doubloon).
Summon a Sea Dog in any space unless (1 doubloon).
Gain 1 action unless (1 doubloon).

cards.title: Show a Leg!
cards.afterText: Summon a Sea Dog in Blackbeard's zone.

decks.name: Chupacabra
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set battle-of-legends-3. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Chupacabra
hero.specialAbility:
THE HUNGER
After you attack, you may draw a card.

cards.title: Ambush
cards.duringText: Your opponent discards 1 random card. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.

cards.title: Blood in the Air
cards.duringText: If you already won a combat this turn, you may BOOST this card.

cards.title: Feeding
cards.afterText: If Chupacabra has 7 or less health, gain 1 action and it recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Natural Toughness
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, return this card to your hand.

cards.title: Ravenous Lunge
cards.afterText: Chupacabra recovers 1 health. If you won the combat, it recovers 2 instead.

cards.title: The More They Struggle
cards.duringText: The value of this card is equal to twice the printed value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: Tooth and Tail
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to up to 2 fighters adjacent to Chupacabra. Chupacabra recovers 1 health for each fighter damaged this way.

cards.title: Traveler of the Night
cards.basicText: Move your fighter up to 4 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Unsettle
cards.basicText: Choose an opponent with a fighter in Chupacabra's zone. They discard 1 card. You may deal 2 damage to Chupacabra to make them discard 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Wounded Beast
cards.duringText: If Chupacabra has 7 or less health, this card's value is 5 instead.

decks.name: Loki
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set battle-of-legends-3. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Loki
hero.specialAbility:
MISCHIEF-MONGER
After you play a TRICK, put that card into your opponent's hand instead of your discard pile. If an opponent discards a TRICK from their hand, return that card to your hand or the top of your deck. Add +1 to your move value for each TRICK in your opponents' hands.

cards.title: Trick: Baldr's Downfall
cards.afterText:
Draw 1 card.
Deal 2 damage to your hero.

cards.title: Trick: Freyja's Rescue
cards.duringText: Swap the values of your card and your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Loki recovers 3 health.

cards.title: God of Mischief
cards.immediateText: If your opponent played a TRICK, ignore that card's value. Otherwise, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Lævateinn
cards.duringText: Reveal a card in your opponent's hand. Add its BOOST value to this card's value. If you reveal a TRICK, put it in your hand.

cards.title: Looking for Trouble
cards.immediateText: If your opponent played a card, return it to their hand, look at their hand, and choose a card for them to play.

cards.title: Malicious Flyting
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If your opponent played a TRICK, draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Ragnarök
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
cards.duringText: Add +3 to this card's value for each TRICK in your opponent's hand.

cards.title: Shapeshifter
cards.duringText: Choose one effect: add +1 to this card's value for each card in your opponent's hand; gain 1 action.

cards.title: Trick: Sindri's Bet
cards.duringText: Your opponent may discard a card. If they don't, subtract 3 from their card's value.
cards.afterText: Loki returns the top card of their discard pile to their hand.

cards.title: Trick: Svaðilfari's Lure
cards.basicText:
Place an opposing fighter adjacent to Loki.
Loki reveals a card in your hand. Discard that card.

cards.title: Underhanded
cards.duringText: If your opponent has more cards in their hand than you, this card's value is 6 instead.

decks.name: Pandora
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set battle-of-legends-3. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Pandora
hero.specialAbility:
PANDORA'S BOX
Do not start with any Kakodæmons on the board. At the start of your turn, open Pandora's Box.

cards.title: Aphrodite's Beauty
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Pandora recovers 1 health for each revealed MISERY.

cards.title: Celestial Raiments
cards.duringText: Ignore the value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: Divine Intervention
cards.afterText: Move Pandora up to 5 spaces.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Forged by Hephaestus
cards.basicText: Place your fighter in any space. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Guided by the Fates
cards.duringText: Discard the top card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, Pandora recovers 2 health.

cards.title: Hera's Curiosity
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each revealed MISERY.
cards.afterText: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.title: Hindsight
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, return a card from your discard pile to the top of your deck.

cards.title: Malice
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 1 card.

cards.title: Offering to the Gods
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Spite
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to your fighter.

cards.title: Zeus's Mischief
cards.basicText: Draw 1 card for each revealed MISERY. Move an opposing fighter up to 1 space. Gain 1 action.
